description: JS <-> Rust parity manifest. Each pair lists JavaScript and Rust source files that implement the SAME logic in the two engines. The CI guardrail (scripts/check-js-rust-parity.mjs) fails any pull request that changes one side of a pair without also changing the other, so the engines can never silently drift apart (issue #126 PR follow-up). To add a newly mirrored module, port it in both languages and append a pair here. See docs/PARITY.md for the full correspondence map, including JS-only modules that are intentionally not mirrored yet.
